Given the scale, complexity and risk profile of cash transfer and incentive payment programmes, UNICEF Afghanistan applies a risk-informed approach to programme monitoring and assurance. This includes routine field monitoring, third-party monitoring, post-distribution monitoring, post-payment verification, grievance redress monitoring and other quality assurance mechanisms to ensure that programmes are implemented effectively, efficiently and in accordance with UNICEF policies and agreed operational procedures.
